info.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued September 25 at 10:58AM PDT until September 30 at 4:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
info.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents and breaking waves due to elevated surf. There is a risk of moderate coastal flooding especially Monday and Tuesday.
* WHERE...Catalina and Santa Barbara Islands, Malibu Coast and Los Angeles County Beaches. Primarily south-facing beaches.
* WHEN...Through Wednesday afternoon.
* IMPACTS...There is an increased risk of ocean drowning. Rip currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Waves can wash people off beaches and rocks, and capsize small boats nearshore. Moderate flooding of sea water is possibly over some vulnerable low-lying coastal areas, especially around the late morning high tide, including over beach parking lots, bike paths, and harbor walkways. Moderate beach erosion is likely. Isolated damage is possible.
* ADDITIONAL DETAILS....Coastal Flood Advisory products will likely be needed for Monday and Tuesday.
info.instruction: Remain out of the water due to hazardous swimming conditions, or stay near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly in such conditions, stay off the rocks.
